messages.subject: INLA_spatio-temporal models - II (Knorr-Held)
parts:
Hi,

I am using spatio temporal model for the Knorr-Held formulation described in "spatio and spatio-temporal bayesian models with R-INLA". Models I, II, and IV, run smoothly, and I can compare the DICs and outputs etc. I cannot seem to sun Model III. It keeps giving me various errors: I use the following code:

data4<-read.csv("FlukeINLA.csv")
Fluke.adj <- paste(getwd(),"/Fluke.graph",sep="")

#--- Type I interaction ---#
formula.intI<- y ~ + f(ID.area,model="bym", graph=Fluke.adj, constr=TRUE, scale.model=TRUE) +
  f(ID.year,model="rw2") + f(ID.year1,model="iid") + f(ID.area.year,model="iid") +
  tempmax+BotSalin+depth+I(tempmax^2)
mod.intI <- inla(formula.intI,family="gaussian",data=data4,
                 control.predictor=list(compute=TRUE),
                 control.compute=list(dic=TRUE,cpo=TRUE))

#--- Type II interaction ---#
ID.area.int <- data4$ID.area
ID.year.int <- data4$ID.year
formula.intII<- y ~ f(ID.area,model="bym",graph=Fluke.adj,scale.model=TRUE) +
  f(ID.year,model="rw2") + f(ID.year1,model="iid") +
  f(ID.area.int,model="iid", group=ID.year.int,control.group=list(model="rw2")) +
  tempmax+BotSalin+depth+I(tempmax^2)

mod.intII <- inla(formula.intII,family="gaussian",data=data4, E = data4$E,
                  control.predictor=list(compute=TRUE),
                  control.compute=list(dic=TRUE,cpo=TRUE),
                  control.inla=list(int.strategy='eb'))

#--- Type III interaction ---#
data4$ID.area.int <- as.integer(data4$ID.area)
data4$ID.year.int <- as.integer(data4$ID.year)

control <- list(predictor = list(compute = TRUE),
  results = list(return.marginals.random = TRUE, return.marginals.predictor=TRUE),
  compute = list(hyperpar=TRUE, return.marginals=TRUE, dic=TRUE, mlik = TRUE, cpo = TRUE,
  po = TRUE, waic=TRUE, graph=TRUE, gdensity=TRUE, openmp.strategy="huge"),
  group = list(model="rw2"))


I get the following error (below ) when I run Model III:

I am attaching the .csv file for your reference! Any help to resolve this will be much appreciated.



Thank you
